# Piano samples

Source: Nicolas Brosowsky, tonejs-instruments, piano sample set.
https://github.com/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments

Samples are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0, as stated in the upstream README (SOURCE.md).

Included files: C2.mp3, C3.mp3, C4.mp3, C5.mp3, C6.mp3, C7.mp3.
Original recordings are unmodified. Playback applies pitch transposition and a note-release envelope.
